item.title: Dipula Properties Secures Inclusion in Key JSE Indices
item.description: Dipula Properties Secures Inclusion in Key JSE Indices. Dipula Properties (JSE: DIB) will be included in the FTSE/JSE All Property Index (ALPI) and the SA REIT Index, effective Monday, 23 March 2026, following the latest index review by the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

item.title: Care, Expertise, and Trust: How Dr Rockson Practice Is Redefining Women’s Health Services
item.description: Discover how Dr Rockson Practice built a trusted women’s health brand through expertise, patient centred care, and continuous learning. Learn key lessons from Dr Esther Rockson’s journey in healthcare.

item.title: Fueling Growth Through Discipline: How Sphiwe Sishi Is Building a Name in the Diesel Supply Industry
item.description: Discover how Sphiwe Sishi is building ABB Petroleum in KwaZulu-Natal’s diesel supply industry. Learn real lessons on trust, consistency, and growing a business through strong relationships.

item.title: Precision, Process, and Persistence: How Design ZA Built a Modern Architectural Brand
item.description: Discover how Design ZA built a modern architectural brand through structured processes, industry experience, and full project lifecycle services. Learn key lessons for growing a design business in South Africa.

item.title: How Just Brands Is Building a Yogurt Business With Purpose
item.description: Discover how Just Brands built a yogurt business in Vosloorus through reseller networks, white label opportunities, and smart product positioning. Learn practical lessons for starting and scaling a food business.

item.title: From Private Practice to Purpose Driven Brand: The Rise of OraMed Psychology
item.description: Explore how OraMed Psychology was built by Dr Mosa Malema from private practice to a growing brand. Learn key lessons on leveraging expertise, CBT practice, and scaling a psychology business in South Africa.

item.title: Shoprite Moves Into Informal Retail Tech With R&A Cellular Stake
item.description: Shoprite Moves Into Informal Retail Tech With R&A Cellular Stake. The Shoprite Group has taken a step to expand its financial services ecosystem into South Africa’s informal economy through the planned acquisition of a majority stake in R&A Cellular. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approval.

item.title: Absa and Feenix Partner to Clear Student Debt, Opening Pathways to Graduation
item.description: Absa and Feenix Partner to Clear Student Debt, Opening Pathways to Graduation. The Absa Group has partnered with the Feenix Trust to address a persistent barrier facing graduates across South Africa by clearing historical student debt at selected public universities.

item.title: The Story Behind Sponzar’s Rise in Africa’s Digital Economy
item.description: Discover how Sponzar is transforming Africa’s creator economy by helping creators monetise their work. Learn key lessons from Clement Sekade on building scalable digital platforms.

item.title: Multi Sector Impact: How Ugagan Built Businesses That Serve and Employ
item.description: Discover how Ugagan built N.I Ugagan Security into a multi business operation employing nearly 180 people. Learn real lessons on diversification, community impact, and business growth in South Africa.

item.title: Thriving Coffee Community: The Story Behind Alchemy Coffee Roasters
item.description: Discover how Alchemy Coffee Roasters grew from a small Cape Town café into a thriving coffee brand. Learn key lessons on community building, product quality, and smart business expansion.

item.title: How Wendy Moshakgs Built a Farming Business From Almost Nothing
item.description: Discover how Wendy Moshakgs built a farming business in Limpopo from recycling cans to supplying retail stores. Learn practical lessons on starting small, scaling steadily, and growing a sustainable business.

item.title: How GUYALL’S Kitchen Built a Catering Brand Rooted in Experience
item.description: Discover how GUYALL’S Kitchen was built by two chefs combining fine dining experience, global exposure, and business insight. Learn practical lessons for starting and growing a catering business.
